findings.location: Paragraph beginning "Morning dawned; it was the day God had told them to go out against these enemies..." (source.html) / corresponding translation paragraph beginning "Surgiu a manhã; era o dia que Deus lhes dissera..." (translation.html)
findings.source_quote: …Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper. And… he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army… – verses 21-20.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the verse-range exactly as printed in the authoritative English source. In the translated paragraph, change the citation back to mirror the source's printed range. Replace “– versículos 21-22.” with “– versículos 21-20.” (Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation.)
findings.translation_quote: … Credes no SENHOR vosso Deus, e estareis seguros; credes nos seus profetas, e prosperareis. E… nomeou cantores ao SENHOR, que deveriam louvar a formosura da santidade, indo à frente do exército… – versículos 21-22.
